THE PRACTICE & PHILOSOPHY

Why statistics shapes how I build and evaluate AI.

Many intelligent systems fail not because models lack capability, but because systems lack empirical measurement. When retrieval-augmented generation produces hallucinations or class imbalance blinds a fraud classifier, intuitive guesswork is never enough.

Trained in demography, survey sampling, and statistical inference, I approach AI engineering with experimental discipline: quantifying retrieval performance with metrics like Recall@K and MRR, calibrating confidence bounds, and designing auditable verification trails into every workflow.
